conversions: A cut-down copy of the shape of planning/paper-verification/allmond2014-ni62/literature.json, for the tests of nucleus.import_points.

BE2_up.method: Coulomb excitation, inverse kinematics, 62Ni beam 1.8 MeV/u on natC (~1 mg/cm2), particle-gamma, GOSIA
BE2_up.reference: J. M. Allmond et al., Phys. Rev. C 90, 034309 (2014) [2014Al20]

BE2_up.method: EVALUATION: ENSDF 2025 adopted B(E2)up = weighted average of Coulex B(E2)
BE2_up.reference: B. Singh, Huang Xiaolong, Wang Xianghan, Nucl. Data Sheets 204, 1 (2025)

BE2_down.method: EVALUATION: ENSDF 2025 adopted B(E2; 2+1->0+1), from adopted T1/2 = 1.442(21) ps
BE2_down.reference: B. Singh, Huang Xiaolong, Wang Xianghan, Nucl. Data Sheets 204, 1 (2025)

tau_2plus.method: DSAM following projectile Coulomb excitation, 62Ni beam 155/160 MeV on 12C
tau_2plus.reference: O. Kenn, K.-H. Speidel, R. Ernst, J. Gerber, P. Maier-Komor, F. Nowacki, Phys. Rev. C 63, 064306 (2001) [2001Ke08]
H. Ohnuma, J. Kasagi, Y. Iritani, N. Kishida, J. Phys. Soc. Jpn. 45, 1092 (1978) [1978Oh04]

tau_2plus.method: DSAM following inelastic neutron scattering 62Ni(n,n'gamma), En = 2.8-4.1 MeV
tau_2plus.reference: A. Chakraborty, J. N. Orce, S. F. Ashley, B. A. Brown et al., Phys. Rev. C 83, 034316 (2011) [2011Ch05]

tau_2plus.method: Nuclear resonance fluorescence (gamma,gamma') with bremsstrahlung, 0.5-1.65 MeV (level width)
tau_2plus.reference: Y. Cauchois, H. Ben Abdelaziz, R. Kherouf, C. Schloesing-Moller, J. Phys. G 7, 1539 (1981) [1981Ca10]

Qs_2plus.method: Reorientation effect in Coulomb excitation, 70-MeV 28Si projectiles on 62Ni target
Qs_2plus.reference: O. Hausser, T. K. Alexander, D. Pelte, B. W. Hooton, Phys. Rev. Lett. 23, 320 (1969) [1969Ha31]

shell_model.method: Shell model, full fp space truncated; ep = 1.5e, en = 0.5e
shell_model.reference: A. Chakraborty et al., Phys. Rev. C 83, 034316 (2011), Table III

shell_model.method: No published shell-model Q_s(2+1) for 62Ni found

other.reference: O. Kenn et al., Phys. Rev. C 63, 021302(R) (2000) [2001Ke02]
